name: FLIXO Agent builds a two-step image compression and WebP plan
description: The Agent should deterministically recognize a compound image request and expose a two-step executable plan before asking for the image.

planSteps.description: Enter `compress this image under 200KB and convert to WebP` in the FLIXO Agent command field
Verify the FLIXO Agent plan-ready card is visible
Verify the plan-ready card reports exactly 2 steps
Verify the page identifies image compression and WebP conversion as the intended work
